meta.title: Teach your agent when to use Modal
meta.description: Gives your agent cloud-compute common sense: when GPUs, large memory or parallel containers are worth it, and when a local script is enough; read before writing, smoke-test before scaling, verify artifacts instead of trusting exit codes, and know the cost class. A short guide — adds no tools, touches no credentials, makes no network calls, harmless if unused. Requires the Modal CLI installed and logged in by you.
